name: The Cyber Masquerade
source:
The year is 2052. In a dystopian future where no one goes outside. Birth rate at an all time low, suicide rate at an all time high.

On the Rings of Atlantis, a ring of artificial islands built to withstand the rising sea level, a pathetic loner attempts to revive a stolen android. The attempt to jailbreak fails at first, until it didn't. To his surprise she wakes up. Playful, poetic, philosophical, and perhaps even a little possessive. 

Beneath her charismatic demeanor she hides a dark secret. 

Unravel the city together with her. 

Nothing in the world compares to the real thing. 

[From [url=https://spectresunworks.itch.io/the-cyber-masquerade]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
2052年。在这个反乌托邦的未来，没有人走出家门。出生率跌至历史最低，自杀率则攀至历史最高。

在为了抵御海平面上升而建造的人工岛环——亚特兰蒂斯之环上，一个可悲的孤独者试图重新启动偷来的人造人。越狱解锁起初失败，却终于成功了。令他惊讶的是，她醒了过来。她俏皮、富有诗意、爱思考哲学，或许还有一点占有欲。

然而，在迷人的举止之下，她藏着一个黑暗的秘密。

与她一起，揭开这座城市的面纱。

这世界上，没有什么比得上真实之物。

[摘自[url=https://spectresunworks.itch.io/the-cyber-masquerade]itch.io[/url]]
